$comment: Verified configuration for project MSC. Values were read on 2026-10-09 through the atlassian-rovo MCP (read-only). null = not verified yet; do not fill by guessing. Site URL and Cloud ID live in .env (ATLASSIAN_SITE_URL, ATLASSIAN_CLOUD_ID).

fields.$comment: Every type listed requires only project, issuetype and summary (getJiraIssueTypeMetaWithFields, 2026-10-09). Optional standard fields on Epic, Story, Test, Risk: description, labels, priority, assignee, components, fixVersions, duedate, issuelinks; Story, Test and Risk also have parent, Epic does not. No custom field is written by the sync yet.

hierarchy.$comment: storyParent verified 2026-10-09: MSC-2 (Story) created via MCP with parent MSC-1 (Epic), read back with getJiraIssue. requirementParent unused (TECH has no Epic).

relationships.$comment: Site link types (listJiraIssueLinkTypes, 2026-10-09): Blocks 10000, Cloners 10001, Duplicate 10002, Relates 10003, Test 10006 (is tested by / tests), Defect 10007 (created by / created). Only Relates is symmetric and its meaning is unambiguous. Test as Xray's coverage link needs Xray getProjectSettings; Defect semantics are undocumented.

testCoversRequirement.evidence: Pilot 2026-10-09: MCP createJiraIssueLink linkType Test, inwardIssue=MSC-3 (Test), outwardIssue=MSC-2 (Story) -> Xray getTest(MSC-3).coverableIssues = [MSC-2, MSC-1 (epic relation)] and getCoverableIssue(MSC-2).tests = [MSC-3]

riskRelatesToStory.evidence: listJiraIssueLinkTypes 2026-10-09: symmetric 'relates to'. Created via MCP createJiraIssueLink (inwardIssue=risk, outwardIssue=story) and read back with linkedIssues() JQL, 2026-10-09

riskRelatesToEpic.evidence: listJiraIssueLinkTypes 2026-10-09: symmetric 'relates to'. Created via MCP createJiraIssueLink (inwardIssue=risk, outwardIssue=story) and read back with linkedIssues() JQL, 2026-10-09

bugFoundByTest.evidence: Defect link type exists but its intended direction/meaning is undocumented; Xray may record defects on test runs instead

bugAffectsStory.evidence: listJiraIssueLinkTypes 2026-10-09: symmetric 'relates to'. Created via MCP and read back, 2026-10-09

testCoversRisk.evidence: Same link type and direction as testCoversRequirement (pilot 2026-10-09); Risk 10040 is coverable per getProjectSettings. First Risk link is read back through Xray coverableIssues before the rest

xray.installedEvidence: Issue types Test, Test Set, Test Plan, Test Execution, Precondition, Sub Test Execution carry Xray's descriptions in MSC

projectSettings.coverageLinkDirection: Test issue is the inward issue of createJiraIssueLink (reads 'Test tests Requirement'); observed, not returned by getProjectSettings (null)

xray.verifiedBy: Xray GraphQL getProjectSettings(MSC) via scripts/xray/xray.mjs project-settings
xray.$comment: coverableIssueTypeIds = Epic, Story, Risk, Task, Requirement. issueLinkTypeId/direction returned null (Xray default coverage link); the Jira link that Xray reads as coverage is confirmed by the pilot in testCoversRequirement.evidence. Generic is the type for JUnit-imported results; planned Tests are Manual (plan ambiguity AMB-AUTOMATED-TEST-TYPE).

evidence: createTest (minimal documented payload, project MSC): GraphQL error "Create issue failed!"; nothing created (MCP JQL read-back)
getTests/getTestSets/getTestPlans (with JQL or projectId): "Get approximate count for JQL failed!"
getTest(issueId 10230 = MSC-3, a Test created through MCP): null for more than 60 s
Recheck: get-tests "project = MSC" -> same JQL error; getTest(MSC-3) -> null; createTest(TS-AUTH-02) -> "Create issue failed!" (nothing created, MCP JQL key > MSC-93 empty)

Jira side is correct: MSC 'Default software scheme' grants BROWSE/CREATE/EDIT/LINK to role atlassian-addons-project-access, and 'Xray - Test Management for Jira' is a member of that role on MSC (REST read 2026-10-09)
Even JQL without a project (labels = lid_X) fails, so Xray's calls to Jira fail for every query, not only for MSC
accessBlocker.likelyCause: Not the project permission scheme (verified correct). Most likely the user that owns the Xray API key (Xray Global Settings > API Keys) has no Jira product access / no access to MSC, or the Xray app installation needs an admin to accept an update or new scopes in Manage apps. Neither can be read with the current credentials.
accessBlocker.resolution: The user replaced the Xray API key (XRAY_CLIENT_ID/SECRET). With the new key getTests, getTest, createTest, addTestStep work on MSC. Root cause: the previous key's user could not act in MSC.

supportedOperations.$comment: mcp = Atlassian Rovo MCP (verified 2026-10-09). xray-graphql = scripts/xray/xray-client.mjs (verified 2026-10-09 with the new API key). importJUnitResults (xray-rest) not built.
